note: Switches event map keys to parsed Uuid, moves uuid validation earlier, uses HashSet for limited ids; the scattered context field logging in the malformed-events warn stays as is.
Removes the auth class's own OIDC public key derivation and calls a new get_oidc_public_key helper added to posthog/jwt.py; moves API-key prefix check into _is_id_jag_token.
Deletes the local escapeHogqlString helper from utils.ts and switches llmTaggerLogic and the lazy loader to the shared escapeHogQLString.
Replaces the HTTP call to the MCP installations API with a direct MCPServerInstallation ORM query filtered by team, user and enabled flag.
Removes summary-ready event capture and its helper/key prefix from the old event-based summarize_session activity, restoring the store function to return None; drops related tests.
Replaces the property with manual cache attribute by functools.cached_property returning the feature check directly.
Passes region into _build_authorize_url, which now uses _region_to_host(region) as the base URL when a region is given; also tightens trusted auth methods.
Adds a WebhookSyncResult dataclass with only success and error, and makes the webhook event sync method return it instead of WebhookCreationResult.
Extracts spawn_merge_writers helper and uses it in both phase_merges and phase_concurrent_reads_writes, removing the duplicated writer loop.
Replaces lazy SVG hoggies with eagerly imported PNG hoggies via pngHoggie across many files; does not make NavPanelAdvertisement a lazy import.
